posts.title: MacRemote: Connect Any Agent to Your Mac’s Tools, Now Free and Open Source
posts.description: I’m pleased to announce my latest free and open-source project, which I’ve been working on for the past six months: MacRemote, a Mac app that lets you securely connect your Mac’s tools and local MCPs to any AI agent of your choice.
